description: Per-occurrence identifier value-category adjudication for the wire identifier properties whose resolved schema terminal constraint does NOT determine the category on its own. Occurrences the type system decides (an anchored ak:<kind>: / ak:did_core: / did: / ak.<symbol> terminal) are deliberately absent: copying an obvious $ref into a hand-kept table would create a second truth that drifts away from the schema. Rows are keyed by (property name, resolved terminal signature); a differently typed occurrence of the same name lands in a different row and fails closed.

classifications.name: action_id
classifications.reason: Exact semantic scope and actual authority are defined by string-profiles.schema.json#/$defs/realm_action_name. Realm-owned action configuration name. The logical owner is the exact Realm, not an individual Event envelope or a Policy rule. Every carrier and update retains that same realm_id; first acceptance fixes (action, policy_scope), and later use must not rebind the name. The name alone is not a capability token, authorization subject, global object identity, or Event deduplication key.

classifications.name: admission_id
classifications.reason: Exact semantic scope and actual authority are defined by string-profiles.schema.json#/$defs/membership_admission_handle. One failed-join admission lifecycle, scoped by its exact source and destination Realm, subject Account and covered join Event/RealmCommit. The handle only correlates the delegation, terminal certificate and one-use compensation binding. Authority remains the verified executor, signed delegation, terminal evidence and current membership cut; the handle alone grants no authority and never replaces Event identity or deduplication.
